psnr_ssim_reference: original degraded input RGB, not clean ground truth
ssim: mean over RGB; Gaussian 11x11 sigma=1.5; population covariance; K=.01/.03
uiqm: Sobel magnitude, RGB-weighted EME .299/.587/.114; 10x10 full blocks; joint-RGB Michelson-log UIConM; all-pixel variance around 10% trimmed mean
uiqm_implementation_note: Explicit common block variant, not a PLIP implementation. Exact trim and .114 blue weight correct off-by-one/.144 in FUnIE-GAN reference code.
uciqe: native D65 CIELab, L=0..100 signed a/b; chroma std, mean top/bottom 1% L contrast, mean C/L
values: per-image metrics, then unweighted image mean; std is across images, not across training seeds
image_precision: same float32 enhanced RGB as paired network input; no saving/reloading JPEG or uint8 quantization
